decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is very close to our core door business and, because it remained on the website in 2024, our existing production and logistics knowledge appears sufficient to keep learning from and profitably run it.

The seventy-two-hour express program also builds directly on our established manufacturing, stock, and service capabilities, and its continued presence in 2024 suggests we can absorb operational feedback and sustain it for urgent-use customer segments.

The express delivery program for doors and gates had its own page in both 2023 and 2024, which indicates strong market relevance and that our related knowledge in customized access solutions lets us refine and commercialize it effectively.

The online ordering and digital services platform fits our move toward deeper advisory and service support, and with in-house R&D plus repeated standalone promotion we have the absorptive capacity to improve and scale it.

The fire and smoke protection door moved from a simple mention to its own page by 2024, signaling positive early results, and it is highly related to our safety-compliant engineering and service knowledge base.
